tasks.spec: You are a one-task Ringer probe worker isolating why createDocument lineItems newCostItem elements fail union resolution in JobTread Pave. Twenty staged documents fail with: The value {"newCostItem":{name, unitId, quantity, unitPrice, costCodeId, costTypeId, description}} at createDocument.$.lineItems.0 does not resolve to existingCostGroup/existingCostItem/newCostGroup/newCostItem. Hypotheses: (A) document-context newCostItem rejects costCodeId/costTypeId keys; (B) the specific costTypeId used ('22PazefY5x4j') or costCodeId ('22PbdLkpZX5s') is invalid in this context; (C) some other inner-field constraint (e.g. name length). BOUNDARY: you may create AT MOST 3 temporary documents on ONE pilot job in JobTread org 22PazeRM5FCH, and you MUST delete every document you create before finishing (deleteDocument op) and prove deletion by read-back; no other mutations of any kind; never touch existing entities; deliverables are your only file writes; never log the grant key. CREDS: set -a; source /Users/chussey/.config/cleverwork/master.env; set +a. Build request bodies with python3 json.dumps only. Pave: POST https://api.jobtread.com/pave with {"query": {"$": {"grantKey": "<$JT_SUPABASE_MIRROR_GRANT_KEY>"}, ...}}. Pick the target job: any jt_id from jt_mirror.crosswalk where jt_type='job' (Supabase read: curl -s -X POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/rnhmvcpsvtqjlffpsayu/database/query -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"select jt_id from jt_mirror.crosswalk where jt_type='\''job'\'' limit 1"}'). PROBE SEQUENCE (stop as soon as one variant succeeds; try in this order): V1 = createDocument {type: <same type value the staged documents use — read one staged payload from jt_mirror.pending_write to copy the exact type/name/jobId shape>, name: 'PROBE-DELETE-ME-V1', jobId: <target>, lineItems: [{"newCostItem": {name: 'Probe Item', unitId: <a real unit id from crosswalk jt_type='unit'>, quantity: 1, unitPrice: 10, description: 'probe'}}]} — NO costCodeId/costTypeId. V2 = same but adding costCodeId only (use '22PbdLkpZX5s'). V3 = same but costCodeId + costTypeId ('22PazefY5x4j') — the known-failing shape as control. Record each full request (grantKey redacted) and full response. CLEANUP: deleteDocument each created id, then re-query it and show null/error proof. DELIVERABLES: /Users/chussey/Documents/a-roofers-open-brain/integrations/bridges/jobtread/mirror/r3h-lineitem-probe/probe-output.json (array of {variant, request, response, cleanup}) and .../r3h-lineitem-probe/probe-transcript.md with sections ## Probe Goal, ## Commands Run, ## Observed Behavior, ## Winning Shape (exact JSON element shape that succeeded, or 'none succeeded'), ## Cleanup Proof, ## Verdict. HARD RULES: never claim a variant worked unless the response contained a created document id; if all fail, that is a valid honest outcome — capture every error verbatim.
tasks.check: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('/Users/chussey/Documents/a-roofers-open-brain/integrations/bridges/jobtread/mirror/r3h-lineitem-probe/probe-output.json')); t=open('/Users/chussey/Documents/a-roofers-open-brain/integrations/bridges/jobtread/mirror/r3h-lineitem-probe/probe-transcript.md').read(); assert isinstance(d,list) and len(d)>=1, 'no probe attempts recorded'; assert any('response' in x for x in d), 'no responses captured'; assert 'winning shape' in t.lower(), 'transcript missing Winning Shape section'; assert 'cleanup proof' in t.lower(), 'transcript missing Cleanup Proof'; assert all('cleanup' in x for x in d if x.get('created_id')), 'created doc without cleanup record'; import re; key=[l.split('=',1)[1].strip() for l in open('/Users/chussey/.config/cleverwork/master.env') if l.startswith('JT_SUPABASE_MIRROR_GRANT_KEY=')][0].strip('\"').strip(\"'\"); blob=json.dumps(d)+t; assert key not in blob, 'SECRET LEAK in probe deliverables'; print('PASS - probe recorded with cleanup and no key leak')"
